settings.q: What is the difference between Energy and Everyday?
settings.a: Both share the same electrolyte base and 1,200mg sodium. Energy adds 150mg natural caffeine from coffee bean. Everyday is caffeine-free and adds Vitamin D3 and Vitamin K2.
Monk fruit extract and Reb M (as OnoSweet). 0g sugar per stick pack.
We ship a 90 day supply in one box every 3 months at 20% off. Skip, swap organic flavors or cancel in your account anytime.

settings.q: How do I skip or cancel?
settings.a: Log in to your account and open your subscription. Skip, swap, change quantity or cancel before your next billing date.
